P_nonHall,LB of the v1 Hall point tests is the per-(state, mode) lower bound of the assembled layer (a) ledger of path P-PBUS (same definition family as v1: TBD load -> 0 W, TBD efficiency -> 1); with today's inputs it equals the v1 value (0 W)
A9.31 sec. 23 items E (ranges) and the binding-constraint decomposition carry the evaluated paths
an M1 readiness listing (sec. readiness) names every required path and whether the harness consumes it

the classification procedure C0..C4, its vocabulary and the A9.32 rules: PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING only from an eligible non-closure demonstrated by evaluated physics under the favorable envelope; SELECT_WITH_EVIDENCE_CONDITIONS only when every required state of both modes is physics-feasible on one hardware with the credible set EMPTY; NOT_DETERMINABLE with the blocking list otherwise

AIR_PRIMARY.robust_set_empty: NH-FLOW OPEN at every required state with GAS_PATH_ROBUST_SET_EMPTY (category DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT: F8 runs on PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY code-default compressor coefficients over the inherited compressor subset with a TBD surface-scenario set; the A9.13 S6.13 flow-gap levers are open); reported as a binding finding with the F8 decomposition (survivors, tiers, infeasibility reasons) exactly as admitted
AIR_PRIMARY.robust_set_non_empty: per-state delivered flow mdot_del(h, s) and mole fractions x_s(h, s) of each robust member h by the F7 chain at state s (plenum / feed through the governed Python reference, or Rust with a run-time cross-check against it on every input of the run; any mismatch -> MODEL_ERROR); the feed loop of h at s is classified by the contract-v8 stability class under a registered controller: UNSTABLE_EQUILIBRIUM is a finding at that state (FEED_LOOP_UNSTABLE_EQUILIBRIUM, DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT) and never a held number; without a registered controller the state is OPEN (FEED_CONTROLLER_NOT_REGISTERED); until the per-state values exist the state is OPEN (GASPATH_PER_STATE_VALUES_NOT_SUPPLIED)
AIR_PRIMARY.closes: eligible (EC-FLOW) at state s iff some robust member h with a stable feed loop at s delivers mdot_del(h, s) >= mdot of a Hall closing point of every AIR test (joint point condition)
AIR_PRIMARY.non_closing: never eligible in A2 (the upstream design grid is not demonstrated bounding; the compressor coefficients are PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY): recorded as GAS_PATH_FLOW_BELOW_HALL_CLOSING_MDOT (DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT)
AIR_PRIMARY.raw_report: the F7 delivered-flow frontier (maximum of mdot_delivered_min_kgps over the Pareto members, per filter / wall context and overall) with its member, xO range, compressor power, intake-face drag and captured-flow minimum; the Hall envelope grid floor (v1 MF-LO 0.377 mg/s) and the ratio; labels PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY and REFERENCE_BOUND_FC00_NOT_ADMISSIBLE where the context carries it

The RFP thrust requirements T12 (HC-01) and T25 (HC-02) are evaluable on their own by the Hall point tests (thrust and bus power only); the record reports this separately. NH-TD stays a required AIR constraint (v1), so an AIR state is PHYSICS_FEASIBLE only with the ICD

paths.quantity: layer (b): HallGate, the mission run hook, the RFP constraint matrix, the official ledger, the mass record, HC-05

joint_point_conditions.rule: for each (state s, mode m) and each Hall test t of m: J_t(s, m) = the envelope points p of the mode's family that pass t with P_nonHall,LB(s, m), and, for every non-Hall input evaluated at points, satisfy it (P-ICP: I_d(p) <= I_e,cap,fav; P-FLOW: mdot(p) <= mdot_del(h, s) for the same robust upstream member h); AIR additionally per composition corner (A1)
joint_point_conditions.state_status: PHYSICS_FEASIBLE iff every required constraint of (s, m) closes eligibly AND some hardware configuration (geometry, bz_shape) has a non-empty J_t(s, m) for every test t of m (AIR: at every composition corner); if every constraint closes but no hardware has all J_t non-empty: NOT_DETERMINABLE with JOINT_CLOSING_POINT_ABSENT (DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT)
joint_point_conditions.no_closing_point: a non-Hall input that is evaluated at points (P-ICP, P-FLOW) while the mode's Hall test has no closing point is OPEN with NO_HALL_CLOSING_POINT (the Hall constraint carries the Hall reason)
joint_point_conditions.architecture_hardware: C3 needs one hardware configuration in the joint hardware set of every required state of both modes (v1 hardware_consistency); otherwise HALL_NO_COMMON_HARDWARE (v1 code)

classification.procedure: v1 classification_rule C0..C4 verbatim, applied to the per-(state, mode) constraint lists of A2
C3_evidence_conditions_added: EC-FLOW: delivered flow from the F7 / F8 chain under PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY inputs (code-default compressor coefficients, TBD surface-scenario set); compressor T-1 / T-2 data, DI-1.3 accommodation evidence and an admitted plenum / feed transient (v8 PARITY_FAIL) remain
EC-ICP: I_e,cap from NP-ICP v2 (IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED, NOT_VALIDATED); HC-05 (M_n,LB > 0 with a VALIDATED_BENCH I_e,cap) and CPL-HALL-ON-v1 not evaluated
EC-PBUS: bus power from a layer (a) ledger at model-derived loads and registered efficiencies; start-up / simultaneous peaks (P_bus,1ms,max) not evaluated
EC-MASS: current-best-estimate mass, not a measurement

category_of_new_codes.every other open code: as v1 (MISSING_EVIDENCE unless v1 or A1 names another category)

classification.today_expected: no envelope: C1, NOT_DETERMINABLE with HALL_ENVELOPE_NOT_RUN first, the AIR chemistry blocker, GAS_PATH_ROBUST_SET_EMPTY and every open non-Hall code; layer (b) NOT_EVALUATED

statuses.CONSUMED: the harness reads the path's producer today and its output (a value or a fail-closed status with reasons) enters every (state, mode) it applies to
statuses.AWAITING_INPUT: the consumer is implemented and exercised by synthetic test-only inputs, but the producer's input does not exist yet (named codes); it is consumed without a code change when the input appears
statuses.BLOCKED: the harness cannot consume the path (no producer interface, or a governance rule forbids it), with the reason

readiness.m1_exit_item: the 196-state closure harness can consume all required physics paths iff no required path is BLOCKED; AWAITING_INPUT paths name the input M2 waits for

fail_closed: any pinned input or A2 / v1 / A1 file whose sha256 differs refuses the record (MODEL_ERROR, exit 4); no partial record
a producer MODEL_ERROR refuses the record; NOT_EVALUATED / INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE / OUT_OF_DOMAIN propagate as OPEN with their codes, never as a closure
a refused IF-ICP-BUS-v2 record (retired key, wrong plane, non-finite or negative power) refuses the record
SYNTHETIC test inputs carry SYNTHETIC_TEST_DATA_NOT_EVIDENCE and never appear in a committed record
determinism: no random input; identical inputs give a byte-identical record (BTreeMap order, fixed float formatting)
